known.via: English Wikipedia "Vallegarcía" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Castilla-La Mancha, formed in 2019 and lying within the La Mancha DO. Its rules allow wine from Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Syrah, with Viognier the only white grape.
